advanced.label: Advanced
advanced.title: Network, identity, security, and wallet controls
advanced.subtitle: These settings are for power users. The normal Send, Receive, and Rooms flows work without reading this section.

rooms.title: Private or public rooms
rooms.subtitle: Private (lock): selected contacts + code. Public: open library for a chosen duration.

send.title: Send files privately
send.subtitle: End-to-end encrypted • Sovereign options available
send.browserOnly: Browser-only mode — sends use a self-contained encrypted link (single file, ≤ 8 MB). No server involved. Connect a Holochain conductor for large files and DHT delivery.
send.dropHint: Click or drop your files here
send.invalidRecipient: Please enter a valid email or phone number.
send.noContacts: No contacts — add one in the Contacts tab.
send.notResolved: Not resolved on the DHT yet
send.agentRegistered: ✓ Agent registered on the DHT — encrypted direct delivery + backup link
send.agentUnknown: ⚠ Contact not registered — a one-time link will be generated (share it yourself)
send.infoCrypto: AES-256-GCM + ECIES/X25519 encryption in the browser. No Filenymous server sees the key or the data. Storage on Holo DHT.
send.localEncryptNote: All files are encrypted locally in your browser.
send.published: Transfer published on the Holo network
send.notified: The recipient was notified in real time via the DHT. Here is the backup link as well.
send.notRegistered: Recipient not registered on the DHT. Share this link yourself (email, SMS, messenger). The decryption key is in the # fragment — it never travels on the network.
send.scanQr: Scan this QR code to open the download link
send.localOnlyProgress: Local encryption — your files never travel in the clear. No third-party server.
send.browserOnlySingle: Browser-only mode can send one file at a time via a self-contained encrypted link. Please send a single file.
send.browserOnlyTooLarge: This file exceeds the {{max}} MB limit for a self-contained link. Use a Holo Web Conductor or a local Holochain conductor for larger files.
send.passwordHint: The file key is derived with Argon2id — the link alone is not enough. Share the password separately.
send.emailCopyDone: ✓ Email copied — paste it into your message
send.emailFallbackHint: If no email app opens, use Copy the email — the message is ready to paste.
send.qrTooLong: This link is too long for a QR code — use Copy to share it.
send.receiptWaiting: Waiting for the recipient to open the link…

optical.sendIntro: No Wi-Fi, no Bluetooth, no server, no internet at all. Point your recipient's camera at this screen.
optical.sizeWarning: This mode is slow for large files — the P2P or link mode will be much faster.
optical.fullscreenNote: This will go fullscreen. Keep both screens on until your recipient confirms.
optical.waitingScan: Waiting for your recipient to scan…
optical.receiveIntro: Point your camera at the sender's screen.
optical.grantCamera: We'll ask for camera access to scan the sender's screen.
optical.scanTip: Turn the sender's screen brightness all the way up. Hold your phone ~20cm away, steady, avoid glare.
optical.fallbackToContact: Ask for a code or link instead
optical.needsPrivateKey: This transfer is encrypted for a specific contact — open it from that contact's session.
optical.lowThroughput: Throughput too low — the camera may not keep up.

receive.title: Receive a file
receive.subtitle: Paste a Magic Link or Filenymous code
receive.keyNote: The decryption key stays in the # fragment — it never travels on the network.
receive.invalidLink: Invalid link or code. Expected format: …/#parcel:key
receive.revoked: This transfer was revoked by the sender.
receive.aesInHash: AES key in the URL # fragment — it never traveled on the network. 100% local decryption.
receive.fileMissingDht: File not found on the DHT.
receive.fileMissingBridge: File not found via Web Bridge.
receive.webLinkNote: Self-contained encrypted link — no server, no conductor.
receive.passwordHint: Enter the password provided by the sender to decrypt.
receive.passwordNote: The password never leaves your browser.

ux.heroSendSubtitle: No cloud. No account. A link, a code, or a room — the rest is transparent.
ux.heroReceiveSubtitle: Paste what you were sent. Decryption stays in your browser.
ux.heroRoomSubtitle: Peer-visible library, private or public — no plugin.
ux.sendDropHint: or click to browse — local encryption right away
ux.sendPathLinkDesc: An encrypted link to paste. Simple and universal.
ux.sendPathContactDesc: Send to someone in your address book (X25519 key).
ux.sendGiveCode: Give this code or link to the recipient
ux.sendQrTitle: Filenymous QR code — scan to open the share
ux.sendWaiting: Waiting for recipient · keep this page open
ux.sendSelfContained: Self-contained link — encrypted content travels inside the link (8 MB max). No server needed.
ux.receiveHint: Paste a link, a code, or scan a QR. Nothing else to configure.
ux.roomHint: Live library across browsers. Private (contacts) or public (limited duration).
ux.contactsSubtitle: Local address book. Add an identity code to send encrypted.
ux.identitySubtitle: X25519 key generated locally. Never leaves your device.

p2p.pathDesc: Live browser-to-browser transfer, any size, nothing stored.
p2p.pathHint: Your files stream directly to the recipient over an end-to-end encrypted WebRTC channel. Keep this tab open until the download finishes.
p2p.keepTabOpen: Keep this tab open: the files are sent straight from your browser. Closing it stops the transfer.
p2p.qrTitle: QR code of the direct-transfer link
p2p.qrCaption: Scan to receive on another device
p2p.waitingReceiver: Waiting for the recipient to open the link…
p2p.peerConnecting: Recipient found — establishing the encrypted direct channel…
p2p.sentComplete: Transfer complete ({{count}} download(s)). Keep the tab open to serve more recipients.
p2p.reconnecting: Connection to the signaling relay lost — reconnecting…
p2p.iceFailed: Direct connection failed (strict NAT/firewall). A TURN relay is required for this network.
p2p.securityNote: End-to-end encrypted (AES-256-GCM per chunk over WebRTC DTLS). The relay only sees connection metadata, never your files.
p2p.unsupported: This browser does not support WebRTC data channels.
p2p.recvWaitingSender: Waiting for the sender — their tab must be open.
p2p.recvReady: Ready. Choose where to save the files.
p2p.roleTaken: Someone else is already receiving this transfer. Try again once they're done.
p2p.senderGone: The sender closed their tab during the transfer.
p2p.memoryWarning: Your browser can't stream to disk: very large files are buffered in memory and may fail. Use a Chromium-based desktop browser for huge files.

dropzone.createIntro: Share a drop link: people send you files straight from their browser to yours. Nothing is stored on a server.
dropzone.keepTabOpen: Keep this tab open: files arrive directly on this device (100% peer-to-peer). If you close it, contributors will see “owner offline” and won’t be able to send anything.
dropzone.ownerReceiving_one: Receiving ({{count}} contributor): do not close this tab.
dropzone.ownerReceiving_other: Receiving ({{count}} contributors): do not close this tab.
dropzone.ownerPrivateLink: This tab’s address is your owner link: keep it private, it reopens the Dropzone. Only share the drop link above.
dropzone.securityNote: End-to-end encrypted (AES-256-GCM, key in the link fragment). Contributors can’t see each other’s files.
dropzone.dropHere: Drag and drop your files here, or click to choose
dropzone.ownerOffline: Owner offline: try again later or contact them.
dropzone.ownerOfflinePending: Owner offline: sending will resume automatically when they’re back. Keep this tab open.
dropzone.contribReady: Owner online: ready for your files.
dropzone.contribComplete: Your files have been delivered to the owner.
dropzone.contribKeepOpen: Transfer in progress: don’t close this tab before the owner confirms.
dropzone.contribPrivacy: Your files go straight to the owner, end-to-end encrypted. Nothing is stored on a server.
dropzone.ownerReceiving: Receiving ({{count}} contributors): do not close this tab.
